Question: Five times \(A\)’s money added to \(B\)’s money is more than \(\$51.00.\) Three times \(A\)’s money minus \(B\)’s money is \(\$21.00.\) If \(a\) represents \(A\)’s money in dollars and \(b\) represents \(B\)’s money in dollars, then:

Choices.D: \(a\gt9,\) but we can put no bounds on \(b\)
